_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: software-architecture
summary: Software estate on a product: systems, components, interfaces, data, environments; what satisfies which requirement, who owns and operates it, what threatens it, which decision shaped it.

changelog.note: Sits on `product` (decided with Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-10-07: product -> software-architecture -> ddd). Its own Requirement, Risk, Document and DecisionRecord are gone: the product's Requirement, Risk, Document and Decision serve, with part_of, owned_by, about, threatens, mitigated_by and documented_in widened to the estate. SA17 asks which requirements nothing satisfies yet. `supports` is `enables` (the product's `supports` is objective to objective). The sample is the estate of the product sample's payments platform.

Declares its shapes: a part belongs to one system, one accountable team, a component or store runs somewhere, a component is part of a system, a repository has an owner and a name; the policy on undocumented decisions names the question it protects (SA13).
Ships its competency questions (questions.json): every class, relation and attribute is cited by a question that runs, and the sample answers each one it must.

Declares its namespace: its terms keep one IRI in the RDF export of every project that uses it. Asset, the kind every system, component, interface and data store is, so one question or rule covers them all.

Repository and implemented_by, attributes for repositories and interfaces, a sample repository, and three actions: a daily repository check and a create-repository action bound to the GitHub MCP server, and a weekly read of what an interface answers.
Carries a guide: what an architecture graph is for and how to read it, installed as GUIDE.md and quoted by the concierge skill.
The architecture app is withdrawn; a generic view for every ontology will follow.
Ships the architecture app: the architecture document read from the graph (views/architecture).
Manifest added; the temporal vocabulary is now inherited from oto-core.
